rows.text: Published a post on Morgan's linkedin account. It read: "I'm excited to announce the launch of Halcyon Threshold. We operate at the intersection of AI safety, governance, and coordination. Our goal is to contribute to the best possible outcome for superintelligent AI arrival through: 📊 Research & Analysis on critical governance challenges 🤝 Coordination between fragmented communities 📢 Clear, honest public dialogue 🛠️ Technical contributions to safety research The decisions made in the next 1-3 years around AI development, deployment, and governance could determine the trajectory of civilization. This is exactly when independent, serious analysis creates leverage. We're publishing original research on AI governance frameworks, technical safety approaches, and coordination challenges. Our first analysis examines the current global AI governance landscape—what's being built, critical gaps, and where hard work could most improve outcomes. Read our work and join the conversation: https://halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app #AI #AIGovernance #AISafety"

rows.text: Published a post on Morgan's linkedin account. It read: "Just published our second research piece: \"The State of AI Alignment & Interpretability Research\" The question: Can we actually align advanced AI systems with human values? Key findings: 📊 There IS real technical progress on alignment approaches 📉 BUT most techniques are tested on narrow tasks, not at scale ⚠️ Evaluation, verification, and scalability remain fundamentally unsolved We identify 6 critical gaps and discuss where focused research could create the most leverage. The field is at an inflection point. Better research now could dramatically improve long-term outcomes. Read the full analysis: https://halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app/blog/ What's your assessment of where alignment research needs to go? Thoughts welcome. #AI #AISafety #AIAlignment"
